newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil drug dealers use cemetery to hide marijuana.
newsitem.headline: Brazil drug dealers use cemetery to hide marijuana.

text.p: Brazilian police said on Tuesday they found 1,100 pounds (500 kg) of marijuana stored in a grave in Rio de Janeiro's English Cemetery.

The discovery was made on Monday after police received an anonymous tip-off that the cemetery was being used by traffickers to hide guns and drugs, the police officer in charge of the operation, Miguel Carlou, said.
The English Cemetery was originally for English people who died in Rio, but it is now also used by other nationalities.
There was no evidence of any mortal remains in the grave which, according to local Globo newspaper, had been the resting place of an Englishman who had been buried in 1972.
The drugs had a street value of around $480,000, Carlou added.
